function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call in the database or CRM. Run this before hanging up the call.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer. Use 'CUST_9988' for Rahul Sharma.

disposition.description: The final categorized outcome of the call.

notes.description: Optional free-text comments describing the details of the call resolution (e.g., PTP date, dispute reasons, transaction references, or callback timings).
